name: @alphabet/security
description: Defence-in-depth supplement for the Alphabet SDK: the ConsentTierManager state machine (NO_MEMORY → ANONYMOUS → CONSENTED → ENRICHED with DNT/GPC auto-downgrade), PII redaction, prompt-injection heuristics, URL/HTML output validation, MemoryIntegrityGuard, and AlphabetAuditLogger. Not a complete security solution; see docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md.
